in_marathi.name: Nabajyoti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabajyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nabajyoti is derived from the Sanskrit words 'naba' meaning new and 'jyoti' meaning star. It symbolizes the birth of a new star or the rebirth of an enlightened soul. In Hindu mythology, the god Jyoti is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom, and the name Nabajyoti is often given to children who are believed to possess these qualities.
